reading.title: Climate Change and Urban Planning
reading.passage: Climate change presents unprecedented challenges for modern cities worldwide. Urban planners must now incorporate sustainable design principles into infrastructure development. Green spaces, renewable energy systems, and efficient public transportation networks are becoming essential components of city planning. Cities like Copenhagen and Singapore have successfully implemented comprehensive climate adaptation strategies, reducing carbon emissions while improving quality of life. These examples demonstrate that integrating environmental consciousness into urban development not only mitigates climate impacts but also creates more livable, economically vibrant communities.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is one essential component of modern city planning?
options: B) Green spaces and renewable energy systems
questions.explanation: 본문에서 'Green spaces, renewable energy systems, and efficient public transportation networks are becoming essential components of city planning'라고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: Which cities are mentioned as examples of successful climate adaptation?
questions.explanation: 본문의 'Cities like Copenhagen and Singapore have successfully implemented comprehensive climate adaptation strategies'에서 답을 찾을 수 있습니다.

questions.q: What does the passage imply about integrating environmental consciousness into urban development?
options: A) It is too expensive to implement
B) It only benefits the environment
C) It creates multiple benefits including economic growth
D) It is not necessary for modern cities
questions.explanation: 'integrating environmental consciousness into urban development not only mitigates climate impacts but also creates more livable, economically vibrant communities'에서 경제적 이득과 환경 개선이 함께 이루어진다고 설명하고 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement: Technology has made people's lives more complicated rather than simpler. Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.

structure.intro: 명확한 입장 표현 (동의 또는 비동의) + 주요 이유 2-3가지를 간단히 언급하는 구성
structure.body1: 첫 번째 이유 상세 설명 (구체적 예시 포함): 기술이 업무 효율성을 높이거나 의사소통을 개선한 사례
structure.body2: 두 번째 이유 상세 설명 (구체적 예시 포함): 기술 의존성 증가, 개인정보 보호 문제 또는 중독 위험성
structure.conclusion: 핵심 주장 재강조 + 기술 사용에 대한 균형잡힌 태도 제시

useful_phrases: On the other hand, some argue that...
In conclusion, while technology presents challenges...

speaking.prompt: Some people believe universities should focus on practical job skills. Others believe universities should focus on theoretical knowledge and critical thinking. Which opinion do you agree with? Explain your reasoning with specific examples.
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I believe that...
sample_points: 이론적 지식 학습이 다양한 산업 분야에 적응할 수 있는 기초 제공 - 예: 기초 수학과 과학이 여러 기술 직업의 기반이 됨
비판적 사고력 발달이 장기 경력 성공과 문제 해결 능력 향상 - 예: 기업들이 특정 기술보다 창의적 사고와 분석력을 가진 직원 선호

listening.title: Professor's Lecture on Marine Biodiversity
listening.script: Good morning everyone. Today I want to discuss the critical importance of coral reefs in maintaining ocean biodiversity. Coral reefs cover less than one percent of the ocean floor, yet they support approximately twenty-five percent of all marine species. These ecosystems are incredibly productive and complex. Unfortunately, coral reefs are facing unprecedented threats from climate change, ocean acidification, and overfishing. When water temperatures rise, corals become stressed and expel their symbiotic algae, a process called bleaching. This disrupts the entire ecosystem because thousands of species depend on coral structures for shelter and food. Recent studies indicate that without intervention, fifty percent of the world's coral reefs could disappear within the next thirty years. We need immediate action through marine protected areas, sustainable fishing practices, and global efforts to reduce carbon emissions. Protecting coral reefs isn't just about saving one ecosystem—it's about preserving the foundation of ocean life itself.

questions.q: According to the professor, what percentage of marine species live in coral reefs?
questions.explanation: 강의에서 'coral reefs support approximately twenty-five percent of all marine species'라고 명확히 언급하고 있습니다.

questions.q: What is coral bleaching caused by?
questions.explanation: 'When water temperatures rise, corals become stressed and expel their symbiotic algae, a process called bleaching'라고 설명되어 있습니다. 물의 온도 상승이 표백 현상의 원인입니다.

questions.q: What does the professor suggest as a solution to protect coral reefs?
options: B) Marine protected areas, sustainable fishing, and reducing carbon emissions
C) Relocating coral to safer waters
D) Building artificial reefs to replace natural ones
questions.explanation: 강의 마지막 부분에서 'We need immediate action through marine protected areas, sustainable fishing practices, and global efforts to reduce carbon emissions'라고 복합적인 해결책을 제시하고 있습니다.
